# `vios_profile` tools

6 tools in the `vios_profile` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client's `tools/list` carries that docstring's prose as the description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_delete_vios_partition_profile` | `destructive` | `vios_profile.delete` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Delete only an unprotected saved profile after an empty unfiltered system-profile inventory. |
| `hmc_list_vios_partition_profiles` | `read` | `vios_profile.list` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | List bounded saved profiles and their contained names,fields and opaque ETags. |
| `hmc_read_vios_partition_profile` | `read` | `vios_profile.read` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Read one exact saved-profile name or UUID within its owning partition. |
| `hmc_save_current_vios_partition_profile` | `destructive` | `vios_profile.save_current` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Save current configuration to a new profile,or force-save after a retained recovery copy verifies. |
| `hmc_set_default_vios_partition_profile` | `mutate` | `vios_profile.set_default` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Select a contained default profile with strict native job results and fresh readback. |
| `hmc_update_vios_partition_profile` | `mutate` | `vios_profile.update` | `vios` | `implemented` | `unevidenced` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Patch typed saved fields with If-Match while preserving the complete fetched document. |
